_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.2.109

The PID page shows current measured-rate controller decisions in mmHg/s and
valve duty percent, when supported by the attached firmware. Inactive position
PID components are identified; stale decisions expire and clear at run boundaries.
Existing firmware stays compatible. Raw data, control and calibration are preserved.

Validated display parsing, expiry, run boundaries, inactive PID terms, offline
status, layout and smoke behavior. Experimental controller changes are excluded.
